newsitem.title: ITALY: Maldives pardons two Italians for drugs crimes.
newsitem.headline: Maldives pardons two Italians for drugs crimes.

text.p: Two Italians sentenced to life imprisonment in the Maldives islands for possession of drugs have received presidential pardons, Italy said on Thursday.
The Foreign Ministry warmly welcomed the gesture in a statement which said the pardons had been signed by President Maumoon Abdul Gayoom.
Davide Grasso, 29, and Stefano Ghio, 39, were arrested separately last year while on holiday on the Indian Ocean islands.
Each was found to be carrying small quantities of hashish or cannabis. Both were sentenced to life imprisonment.
The cases caused shock in Italy, where possession of small amounts of soft drugs for personal use is not an offence and the Italians' punishment was widely regarded as excessive.
Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro had led calls for clemency from the Maldives.
